operations.longDescription:
Returns the policies of the account. Filter with `identity`, `resourceURN` and `action`.
Set `readOnly` to true to include the read-only policies generated by OVHcloud.
Set `details` to true to expand resource information.

Creates a policy that grants one or more identities access to a set of resources.

`identities` are URNs: `account` (NIC), `user` (`account-id/username`) or `group` (`account-id/group-name`).
`resources` are `resource` or `resourceGroup` URNs.
Both actions and resource URNs may end with `*` to match several items at once.

`permissions.allow` is the set of granted actions: everything else is denied by default.
`permissions.except` subtracts actions from that allow set (useful with wildcards).
`permissions.deny` forbids actions outright and always wins, including over allows from other policies.

Optional `permissionsGroups` attach reusable allow/deny sets defined separately.
Optional `conditions` (AND / OR / NOT / MATCH over resource type, tags, name, request IP, date/time) must evaluate true for the policy to apply.
Optional `expiredAt` disables the policy after that date.

A policy can target another OVHcloud account: the recipient can re-delegate only within the rights received, never beyond them.
Deletes the policy and the access it granted.

A resource represents any service bought by a customer and any asset that can be delegated in the IAM. A resource group is a set of resources belonging to a specific owner.
